deterministic.evidence: Manual byte comparison: tests/tools/score.py SHA256 13DE2B3885967E22AA13DED3BF33C354E3E741E85BE871612C04E996EEF5C04E and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py SHA256 03C1426F00E451F4D86B7547761715328C63CDF299F5F812F46C9FA3B44979B5 exactly match the frozen template files. task.toml [verifier.env] matches the frozen template block, including the OpenRouter variable template.

deterministic.name: check-demo-accounts-agree.py

deterministic.name: check-dockerfile-references.sh

deterministic.name: check-dockerfile-sanity.sh
deterministic.evidence: The frozen deterministic reference makes this common apt-pinning checker a NOTE-only override for WebDev; environment/Dockerfile:5 and tests/Dockerfile:11 use apt for system packages, which check-dockerfiles.py owns.

deterministic.name: check-dockerfiles.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual frozen-template comparison: environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to its frozen template and installs Node 22, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 while COPYing only instructions/assets; tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to its frozen template, pins npm tools and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, and COPYs . to /tests at line 43. No image build was run in this read-only review.

deterministic.name: check-fixtures.py

deterministic.name: check-instruction-content.py

deterministic.name: check-instruction-hygiene.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual scan of instruction.md and six environment/instructions/*.md notes found no criterion IDs, judge/rubric/reward/Playwright vocabulary, placeholder token or copied criterion paragraph. The notes state product behavior and the runtime contract.

deterministic.name: check-instruction-states-offline-constraint.py
deterministic.evidence: task.toml [environment].network_mode="public" and [verifier.environment].network_mode="public"; the frozen workbook declares this offline-constraint check NOTE-only and no offline sentence is required.

deterministic.name: check-instruction-suffix.sh
deterministic.evidence: Manual tail check: instruction.md ends with the request to open, edit, run and inspect without signing in; it has no terminal-bench time-limit or anti-cheat suffix, matching the WebDev override.

deterministic.name: check-no-cdn-or-remote-assets.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual profile check: task.toml sets public network for both phases and environment/instructions/security.md:3 explicitly allows public app assets. The frozen workbook makes CDN/off-origin findings NOTE-only on public network; no offline/allowlist restriction applies.

deterministic.name: check-no-host-paths.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual scan of authored task text outside bundled dependencies and built JS found no /Users/<name>, disallowed /home/<name>, C:\Users, or Documents and Settings path. Public notes use container paths such as /app and /assets.

deterministic.name: check-no-literal-secrets.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual scan of authored files found no provider-key shape or PEM block. task.toml [verifier.env].ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty, identical to the frozen template; the app has no account password.

deterministic.name: check-no-placeholders.sh
deterministic.evidence: Manual scan of authored instruction/notes/config/scripts outside vendor dependencies and generated public bundles found no unfinished CHANGE_ME, TODO, FIXME, XXX, <placeholder> or lorem ipsum marker. Vendor TODO comments and an XXX substring inside a package-lock integrity hash are not task placeholders; the shipped vendor tree is independently failed as stray files.

deterministic.name: check-no-stray-files.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual tree check: solution/app/node_modules/ is present with 123 top-level package directories and node_modules/.package-lock.json. Frozen staged-task-contract.md says shipped node_modules and build residue are forbidden; solution/app/** does not waive that exclusion.
deterministic.counterexample: A package built from this frozen tree includes the entire installed dependency tree as task material, so the closed-list/stray-file checker rejects an otherwise valid task.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Remove solution/app/node_modules from the candidate and rebuild any required runtime artifacts from declared pinned dependencies before a new freeze.

deterministic.name: check-no-trialforge-judge-keys.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual scan of all five tests/{gates,scored}/*/judge.toml files: no files or target_claims TrialForge keys; task tests/ has no tests/expected or tests/<dimension>/check.py Toolathon structure.

deterministic.name: check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled.py
deterministic.evidence: solution/app/package.json declares runtime dependencies including React, Acorn, Prettier, Express and better-sqlite3; environment/Dockerfile preinstalls only Express and better-sqlite3. task.toml sets public network, so the frozen workbook rates missing manifest preinstalls as NOTE rather than FAIL. The reference currently ships node_modules, separately failed as stray.

deterministic.name: check-probe-not-in-seed.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual probe check: environment/assets/seed_data.json has an empty snippets array; the functional criterion?s distinctive MULTI multi-caret string and judge-created unique snippet values are absent from it and from initial solution/app/src/app.tsx and solution/app/index.html. No sentinel is pre-satisfied by the seed.

deterministic.name: check-required-files.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual closed-list comparison: required staged files, including tests/app_context.md and both tools, exist, but solution/app/node_modules/ is shipped. Frozen staged-task-contract.md explicitly forbids node_modules in the task folder.
deterministic.counterexample: A candidate archive retaining solution/app/node_modules violates the staged layout even if all required paths are present.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Remove bundled node_modules from the task candidate and ensure the reference remains installable/runnable through permitted pinned artifacts.

deterministic.name: check-reward-schema.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual shape check: tests/scoring.toml has staged [gates]/[weights]/[floors] and no tests/reward.toml. The workbook says this retired reward-schema checker is NOTE-only for staged tasks.

deterministic.name: check-reward-weights.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual shape check: tests/scoring.toml owns 0.6/0.2/0.2 weights; tests/reward.toml is absent as required. The retired reward-weights checker is a staged no-op.

deterministic.name: check-rubric-prompt.py
deterministic.evidence: All five tests/*/*/prompt.md files contain {criteria} and localhost URL but none contains {app_context}; tests/test.sh:197-200 attempts context substitution, which therefore does nothing. The three scored prompts also omit the documented in-dimension browser gate that hard-zeros a blank/static shell.
deterministic.counterexample: A scored judge can act without the prepared app context and apply visual/polish criteria to a shell after a mistaken upstream gate pass; the required scored prompt guard is absent.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Insert {app_context} and an explicit scored-dimension live-app browser gate in each applicable prompt while preserving the current task-specific instructions.

deterministic.name: check-rubric-schema.py
deterministic.evidence: All five judge.toml files parse and carry Playwright MCP, but tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:8-12 declares only playwright. It has no verifier MCP server or $APP_RESTART_HELPER argument, despite tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:203 requiring restart_app and tests/test.sh:193 exporting the helper.
deterministic.counterexample: A correct app cannot earn the restart criterion because the functional judge has no restart_app tool to call.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Add the frozen-contract verifier MCP server entry with /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and literal $APP_RESTART_HELPER to functional/judge.toml.

deterministic.name: check-rubric-segments.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual shape check: this staged task has five judge.toml files and no legacy tests/rubric/browser/segments.json; the workbook defines the legacy segments checker as a no-op here.

deterministic.name: check-runtime-contract-strings.py
deterministic.evidence: environment/instructions/integration.md:3-7 states node /app/server.js, port 3000 and GET /api/health, but it never states DB_PATH. tests/test.sh:98-109 chooses /app/app.db (or /tmp/submission/app.db) and injects DB_PATH; the frozen staged contract and checker require injected runtime variables to be public.
deterministic.counterexample: A conforming builder following the public notes can choose another durable database path while a hidden test-only DB_PATH/app.db convention remains unexplained.
deterministic.suggested_fix: State the DB_PATH behavior and any required database path in the public integration note, or resolve this shared-template contract conflict before refreezing.

deterministic.name: check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual Dockerfile comparison: environment/Dockerfile:10-12 installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1; tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs the same two exact runtime versions. Other package.json dependencies are not preinstalled in either base image and are covered as a public-network NOTE.

deterministic.name: check-scoring-policy.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual parse: tests/scoring.toml has binary zero-weight render/constraints gates, positive functional/polish/visual weights 0.6/0.2/0.2 totaling 1 and functional floor 0.05. tests/test.sh:211-226 runs gates then scored and score.py after each; each judge timeout is below its suite limit and 1500+11100<13200. Gate maxima 900+600 equal the 1500-second suite allowance with --max-concurrent-agent 1, leaving no worst-case overhead; full judge duration is unmeasured, so this is workload risk, not a measured failure.

deterministic.name: check-solve-contract.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual syntax/contract check: bash -n passes for LF-only solution/solve.sh; it copies solution/app into /app at line 40, checks /app database files for active use before installer-only reset at lines 10-37, and does not write /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, pkill, or set NODE_ENV=production.

deterministic.name: check-task-name.py
deterministic.evidence: task.toml [task].name is turing/colderwater-playground-devtools. The assignment identifies colderwater-playground-devtools as the logical task folder; the frozen snapshot directory named task is explicitly not an identity defect.

deterministic.name: check-verifier-contract.py
deterministic.evidence: bash -n passed for tests/test.sh and its zero-reward trap/two-suite order are present. However tests/test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER while tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:8-12 lacks the required verifier MCP entry consuming it; the functional criterion at line 203 requires restart_app.
deterministic.counterexample: The verifier can launch and score a working app but cannot provide the named process-restart observation to its functional judge.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Wire the functional judge to the existing single-use restart_mcp.py helper, then verify a real restart/readback.

deterministic.name: check-task-slug.sh

deterministic.name: check-test-file-references.sh
